install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-79a5e7cb2b9da8e4624f，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-voice-input-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-79a5e7cb2b9da8e4624f.html
posts.en:
dsh-voice-input-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-79a5e7cb2b9da8e4624f.html
